source: Météo-France SIM decadal plus IGN/ASP RPG 2015 parcel areas

rpg_metadata.haricot_mask: No PHS parcels were returned in the executed 2015 extraction; haricot uses general agricultural soil features. PHS, if present in another extraction, groups dry peas and dry beans and would only be a proxy.
rpg_metadata.aggregation: parcel reported hectares, point-on-surface assignment to containing department and nearest native 8-km grid centre
rpg_metadata.missing_groups: Groups absent from this file have no usable 2015 parcel mask; model must explicitly fall back to general agricultural soil features

spatial_method: fixed RPG 2015 reported parcel area, point-on-surface assigned to containing department and nearest 8-km SIM centre; weights normalized per department/crop
fallback: exact existing CLC 2012 agricultural SIM values where crop-specific RPG weights are absent; all wheat and haricot groups are fallback in this extraction
temporal_method: decadal means day-weighted; flux sums prorated by overlap days; partial-decade approximation
availability_note: 2015 footprint is fixed across historical weather years. No annual crop-mask or rotation claim. Current reanalysis and source vintage are retrospective; pre-season decisions replay only past weather years.
